composition.basket: One unchanged painted region from feeding-basket-pose-14-candidate-v2.png, shared by all four poses. Explicit integer offsets only. No per-part scaling, rotation, warping or silhouette fitting.
composition.normalization: Compose at integer source coordinates; normalize the whole frame once. Per-crop downscaling was rejected after independent pixels exposed resampling phase differences.
composition.foreground: Fixed body-bound pixel runs authored from pose polygons, excluding registered shirt/shorts material pixels. Original RGBA ownership is disjoint. No body/equipment raster edits or runtime colour segmentation.

findings: Fine woven strands and subdued basket contents improve the original chunky/bean-like candidates.
Shared basket source prevents per-pose changes in weave, physical size and lighting.
Precise foreground masks remove garment patches previously restored over the basket.

Loose seeds remain larger than the 7-9 source-pixel request in some generated sources; pose 13 also has three visible kernels rather than four requested. Final seed scale/palm semantics remain under review.
Whole-pose cadence remains discrete. This increment does not approve all character art or animation.
